digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup/runtime architecture
propositions: MCP and review-bot must capture static deployment/policy config once at process startup and compose a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot for each operation, leaving request-scoped inbound auth transient and never stored in config

Decision-bearing Gerrit/GitHub/LLM auth must be validated before accepting work (before dedup/clone/provider operations), failing closed with no principal fallback if auth is missing, blank, conflicting, or revoked
The composed LLMRuntime from startup binding must be forwarded through CodeReviewRequest and adapter construction to ensure consistent runtime identity across the operation
Inbound MCP bearer tokens must remain request-local via PROXY_IDENTITY ContextVar and never appear in OperationSnapshot serialization, logs, caches, schemas, or child environments
Static config rotation is observed only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned credential refresh behavior remains unchanged and in-process
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup disables telemetry with no impact on the underlying operation result, while security-critical auth remains fail-closed
